scope: Owner-requested UI fix for workspace Start displaying a JSON document

behavior.html_workspace_forms: 303 redirect to the same dashboard after successful lifecycle admission
behavior.pending_workspace: Refresh authenticated GET every two seconds; disable duplicate controls
behavior.ready_link: Shown only when current controller status is Running and the gateway ready snapshot has arrived
behavior.errors: Rejected or malformed lifecycle replies retain failure responses without success redirect

regressions: JSON and legacy no-Accept caller compatibility
rejected admission and malformed response retain errors
dashboard GET refresh does not repeat POST
transitional states and stale generation suppress access
ready snapshot delay keeps refresh active

chromium.environment: Local HTTPS gateway with synthetic identity/controller; no Cloudflare or live inference
chromium.initial_probe_attempts: The intercepted-request fixture did not follow redirects reliably; replaced with direct loopback HTTPS. A selector was narrowed to distinguish the synthetic broker status from the workspace status. Production code did not change for these fixture corrections.

deployment.method: Existing Ansible services role; no database initialization/migration or private credential replacement

live_browser_confirmation.scope: Response to the deployed Stop then Start check: return directly to dashboard and reveal access automatically

limitations: Live browser acceptance is owner-reported; no independent authenticated browser trace or browser/version details were captured.
Complete administrator grant/reset/revocation acceptance remains outside this fix.
